hero.quote: "An exciting Thomson Perrett designed course located just outside Ho Chi Minh City, characterized by picturesque lakes and excellent conditioning."

overviewParagraphs: West Lakes Golf & Villas brings a high-quality golf experience to the western suburbs of Ho Chi Minh City. The Thomson Perrett design makes exceptional use of the flat terrain by incorporating vast lakes, which come into play on numerous holes, requiring accuracy and thoughtful course management. The conditioning is consistently top-tier, thanks to the use of Zeon Zoysia grass, which provides lush, green fairways year-round. The greens are well-guarded and fast, ensuring a test for all skill levels. Coupled with a modern clubhouse, expansive practice facilities, and luxurious on-site villas, West Lakes is an ideal destination for a day trip from the city or a relaxing golf getaway.

curatorBriefHtml: West Lakes Golf & Villas (opened 2018 in Long An Province) brings respected Australian design firm Thomson Perrett (founded by five-time Open Champion Peter Thomson) to Southern Vietnam. Measuring 6,634 yards from the Blue Tees (Par 72), the layout pairs crisp Zeon Zoysia fairways and TifEagle greens with strategic lakes, crisp bunker edges, and clean, fair Australian-style shotmaking.

Having played West Lakes personally, what makes it shine — especially for Australian and international groups — is its honest, playable architecture and serene lakeside setting away from urban clutter. Water comes into play on most holes, yet Thomson Perrett consistently leaves a smart bailout angle for thoughtful golfers rather than punishing slight misses unfairly.

Situated roughly 65–75 minutes west of District 1, Ho Chi Minh City (near Sir Nick Faldo’s Royal Long An), West Lakes is an excellent weekday addition for returning Saigon golfers seeking fresh Zeon Zoysia conditioning and relaxed pace of play.

scorecard.verdict: The first course in Western Ho Chi Minh City to feature Zeon Zoysia grass from tee to green. Designed by Thomson Perrett, it weaves through vast lakes with superb year-round turf.

faqs.q: Who designed West Lakes Golf & Villas and how does it play?
faqs.a: West Lakes was designed by Australian firm Thomson Perrett (Par 72, 6,634 yards Blue Tees). Expect crisp Zeon Zoysia fairways, strategic water hazards with thoughtful bailout angles, and smooth TifEagle putting surfaces.

faqs.q: How far is West Lakes Golf & Villas from central Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Allow 65 to 80 minutes west of District 1, Ho Chi Minh City in a private touring vehicle; departing around 07:00 AM avoids city exit traffic.

faqs.q: Can West Lakes be paired with Royal Long An?
faqs.a: Yes — both courses sit in Long An Province west of Ho Chi Minh City, making them easy additions for longer 5- to 7-day Southern Vietnam itineraries alongside VGCC and The Bluffs Ho Tram.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play West Lakes?
faqs.a: December through April brings reliable dry-season sunshine; May through November morning rounds stay cool and finish comfortably before afternoon tropical showers.
